Title: A clean held change is reported exactly on the Nth tick
Preconditions: Instance initialised with threshold_ticks=5 (TEST-ONLY); stable_value=0x00 (A)
Inputs: raw_value=0x01 (B, TEST-ONLY) held for 5 consecutive Update calls
Expected_Result: Calls 1-4: status OK, changed_out=false, stable_out=0x00; call 5: status OK, changed_out=true, stable_out=0x01

Title: A short-lived candidate value never reaches the stable output
Preconditions: Instance initialised with threshold_ticks=5 (TEST-ONLY); stable_value=0x00 (A)
Inputs: raw_value=0x01 (B, TEST-ONLY) held for 3 calls, then raw_value=0x02 (C, TEST-ONLY) held for 5 consecutive calls
Expected_Result: stable_out moves directly from 0x00 to 0x02 on the 5th call of the C run; stable_out is never 0x01 on any call; changed_out is true only on that call

Title: Output holds the safe default until the first raw value is confirmed
Preconditions: Instance initialised with safe_default=0x00 (D, TEST-ONLY) and threshold_ticks=5 (TEST-ONLY)
Inputs: raw_value=0x00 (D) held for 2 calls, then raw_value=0x01 (X, TEST-ONLY) held for 5 consecutive calls
Expected_Result: stable_out=0x00 on every call until the 5th call of the X run, where changed_out=true and stable_out becomes 0x01

Title: The changed flag pulses once and clears on the following tick
Preconditions: Instance initialised with threshold_ticks=5 (TEST-ONLY); stable_value=0x00
Inputs: raw_value=0x01 (TEST-ONLY) held for 10 consecutive calls
Expected_Result: changed_out=true only on call 5; changed_out=false on calls 1-4 and 6-10; stable_out=0x01 from call 5 onward

Title: Arbitrary opaque byte codes are debounced without reinterpretation
Preconditions: Instance initialised with threshold_ticks=5 (TEST-ONLY); stable_value=0x00
Inputs: raw_value takes 0x01, then 0x80, then 0xFF (TEST-ONLY representative codes), each held for 5 consecutive calls in turn
Expected_Result: Each code becomes stable_out on its own 5th call with changed_out=true; no code is rejected, clamped, or substituted

Title: Reported latency from a differing sample to changed equals the threshold in ticks
Preconditions: Instance initialised with threshold_ticks=5 (TEST-ONLY); stable_value=0x00
Inputs: raw_value=0x01 (TEST-ONLY) held from call 1 onward; the call number where changed_out first becomes true is recorded
Expected_Result: changed_out first becomes true on call 5, exactly threshold_ticks calls after the first differing sample; this is a TEST-ONLY reference value, not a verified response-time budget

Title: Two instances updated in the same loop remain independent
Preconditions: Two separate instances, each initialised with threshold_ticks=5 (TEST-ONLY); instance 1 stable_value=0x00, instance 2 stable_value=0x01
Inputs: Instance 1 fed raw_value=0x01 for 5 calls; instance 2 fed raw_value=0x00 for 5 calls, one call per instance per loop iteration
Expected_Result: Instance 1 stable_out becomes 0x01 on its 5th call; instance 2 stable_out becomes 0x00 on its 5th call; neither instance's counters or stable value affect the other

Title: A bounce of exactly one tick never changes the output
Preconditions: Instance initialised with threshold_ticks=5 (TEST-ONLY); stable_value=0x00 (A)
Inputs: raw_value=0x01 (B, TEST-ONLY) for 1 call, then raw_value=0x00 (A) for 1 call
Expected_Result: changed_out=false on both calls; stable_out=0x00 throughout; count_ticks=0 after the second call

Title: A bounce one tick short of the threshold never changes the output
Preconditions: Instance initialised with threshold_ticks=5 (TEST-ONLY); stable_value=0x00 (A)
Inputs: raw_value=0x01 (B, TEST-ONLY) for 4 calls, then raw_value=0x00 (A) for 1 call
Expected_Result: changed_out=false on every call; stable_out=0x00 throughout; count_ticks=0 after the final call

Title: Input alternating every tick never accumulates toward the threshold
Preconditions: Instance initialised with threshold_ticks=5 (TEST-ONLY); stable_value=0x00 (A)
Inputs: raw_value alternates 0x01, 0x00, 0x01, 0x00 and so on for 20 calls (TEST-ONLY length)
Expected_Result: changed_out=false on every call; stable_out=0x00 throughout

Title: A cancelled candidate restarts the full threshold count on its next attempt
Preconditions: Instance initialised with threshold_ticks=5 (TEST-ONLY); stable_value=0x00 (A)
Inputs: raw_value=0x01 (B, TEST-ONLY) for 4 calls, then raw_value=0x00 (A) for 1 call, then raw_value=0x01 (B) held for 5 further consecutive calls
Expected_Result: changed_out=false through the cancellation; changed_out=true only on the 5th call of the second B run, five calls after the reset, not on the 4th

Title: The tick counter saturates at the threshold and never exceeds it
Preconditions: Instance initialised with threshold_ticks=65535 (TEST-ONLY, maximum representable value); stable_value=0x00
Inputs: raw_value=0x01 (TEST-ONLY) held for 70000 consecutive calls, far beyond the threshold
Expected_Result: changed_out=true exactly once, on call 65535; stable_out=0x01 from call 65535 onward; count_ticks reads 0 on every call after the change, never exceeding 65535 and never wrapping

Title: With a one-tick threshold a single differing sample changes the output immediately
